entries.1d2afb4de2b16d65: METAWATER Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive water environment engineering company that handles everything from the design and construction of mechanical and electrical equipment for water purification plants and sewage treatment plants to the operation of the facilities.
entries.5e09107d92a4b5e9: This business designs and manufactures electrical equipment and the like for water purification plants and sewage treatment plants. Amounts are disclosed only for the System Solutions Business, and no amount for this business alone is printed.
entries.629c726ebe6290a8: This business designs and manufactures electrical equipment and the like for water purification plants and sewage treatment plants in Japan, and carries out maintenance and upkeep. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥61,154 million, the largest of the four segments.
entries.d28646a9ab06c44d: This business handles mechanical equipment and the like for resource recycling facilities. Amounts are disclosed only for the Environmental Engineering Business, and no amount for this business alone is printed.
entries.d6662979878657ec: This business operates water purification plants, sewage treatment plants and resource recycling facilities in Japan. It is carried out by a subsidiary serving as the vehicle for public-private partnerships, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥33,455 million.
entries.e38f29394124bdba: This business designs and builds mechanical equipment and the like for water purification plants, sewage treatment plants and resource recycling facilities in Japan, and carries out their maintenance and upkeep. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥58,475 million.
entries.e5daf36d0620f8c4: This business handles mechanical equipment and the like for water purification plants and sewage treatment plants. Amounts are disclosed only for the Environmental Engineering Business, and no amount for this business alone is printed.
entries.f9dba703ca6a0ce3: This business carries out maintenance and upkeep of electrical equipment and the like for water purification plants and sewage treatment plants. Amounts are disclosed only for the System Solutions Business, and no amount for this business alone is printed.
entries.ffa6da623027f0a2: This business designs and builds facilities and equipment for water purification plants and sewage treatment plants overseas, carries out their maintenance and upkeep, and conducts private-sector business. Mainly through subsidiaries in North America and Europe, revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥56,759 million.
